text: As part of the approval for Item TE1.30, Toronto and East York Community Council requested a report on the feasibility of establishing a construction hub within the Yonge Street and St. Clair Avenue area. This staff report provides an overview of the Construction Hub requirements, feasibility review and recommendations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested Transportation Services staff to hold regular meetings with the resident associations, local Business Improvement Areas and developers to discuss upcoming construction activities and proposed construction management plans.
